page.title: ROB RUN: Free-to-Play Crime Sandbox Guide
page.meta_description: ROB RUN is a free-to-play early access crime sandbox from Kefir. Team up in clans, build a hideout, and fight thousands of real players on Windows.
page.tagline: Every cop and criminal is a real player in this brutal crime sandbox.
overview: ROB RUN is a free-to-play, early access crime sandbox from developer and publisher Kefir. The Steam page describes a brutal world where every cop and every criminal is a real player, with 5,000 players around you and situations that can quickly spiral out of control.

You can survive alone, but the description says you only thrive by working together. Create or join a clan, assign roles, organize raids, take territories, wage gang wars, and negotiate truces. Every minute you risk losing everything, so planning, quick decisions, and timing matter.

Your hideout is your castle: build and upgrade a base, store loot and vehicles, and place workbenches and safes. The more lavish your refuge, the more intruders you attract. The page also notes server wipes, so even a week-long rise from thug to boss can reset and start again.

facts.value: Action, Massively Multiplayer, RPG, Simulation, Free To Play, Early Access

how_to_play: Start from the bottom as a regular thug in a player-driven crime sandbox.
Decide whether to survive solo or join/create a clan for raids, territory control, and gang wars.
Plan your moves and stay ready to lose everything—someone can take what's yours at any minute.
Build and upgrade a hideout to store loot and vehicles, but expect more intruders if it looks lavish.
Take part in robberies, hideout raids, police chases, and shootouts to gain resources and influence.
Prepare for server wipes; a week can take you from thug to boss, then reset with new experience and allies.
tips: Clans are the fastest route to power: the Steam page says solo players can survive, but thriving requires teamwork.
Betrayal is part of the sandbox—reliable allies are described as your most valuable asset.
Don't overbuild your hideout early; a lavish refuge attracts more intruders.
Plan and make quick decisions; the page stresses there's no room for error.
YouTube guides highlight solo PvP and looting as paths to big money, including a '$2,000,000 in 1 HOUR' run.
Expect server wipes and treat each one as a fresh start with new allies and a more ambitious plan.

faq.q: Is ROB RUN free to play?
faq.a: Yes. The Steam store lists it as free to play.

faq.q: What platforms is ROB RUN on?

faq.a: Kefir is listed as both developer and publisher.
Yes, Early Access is included in the Steam genres.

faq.q: How many players are in a server?
faq.a: The Steam description says 5,000 players around you.

faq.q: Can I play ROB RUN solo?
faq.a: The description says you can survive on your own, but you only thrive by working together. YouTube videos also show solo PvP and looting.

faq.q: Does ROB RUN have server wipes?
faq.a: Yes. The Steam description mentions server wipes and a one-week rise from thug to boss.
